Name: Music Instruments
Author: MoreMusic
Description:
This mod uses (DGA) (dynamic game assets) to add my custom music instruments and other things to the furniture catalogue.
The guitars on the wall are in the paintings section and there are three foam panel sizes there also in the furniture catalogue.

My mod is inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16317]DGA Sam's Band Instruments (Furniture)[/url] so give that mod a download if you like this one.
This is my first ever mod I'm hoping there's no issues.

Update 1.1.0 adds a drum stool and fixes a couple of small sprite issues I didn't like. If you update this mod I recommend any items you've added from the furniture catalogue from 1.0.0, just place them in the in game bin and just replace the items you want to use.
